audited_candidate.scope: unbuilt test-only exact-M1 32x512 cooperative or persistent kernel combining the production gate/up dead-up phase with the immediately following production down/residual/norm phase

audited_candidate.arithmetic_feasibility: A bit-exact implementation is statically possible if every existing BF16 boundary and arithmetic order is retained, but no compiled, correctness, resource, Graph, or performance claim exists.

nsight_systems_evidence.evidence_role: existing production topology and timing evidence; no new profiling was run
nsight_systems_evidence.selection_method: Select completed q3x.decode.step NVTX ranges, join contained CUDA runtime calls to kernels by correlationId and globalPid, partition each range and stream by GPU start time, and inspect LEAD(name,start) after every production gate/up row.

host_launch_calls.critical_path_interpretation: The CPU had already submitted both launches at least hundreds of microseconds and typically about 50 ms before GPU execution. The approximately 0.419-ms/token gate/up API duration is overlapped host work and cannot be added to the 0.0857856-ms/token GPU boundary gap.

prior_launch_amortization_cross_check.interpretation: The earlier topology-only heuristic is close to and conservatively above the exact current 0.0857856-ms boundary sum.

down packed-weight and canonical or scale6 scale loads
gated BF16 publication and complete per-CTA down activation staging
raw-down, residual, and normalized BF16 boundaries

reusable_codebook_setup_only.reason_barrier_remains: The complete 17408-element gated activation must still be staged for down and synchronized within every CTA.

traffic_and_setup_ceiling.required_new_cost: A cooperative grid barrier between gate/up publication and down consumption is unavoidable because every down CTA consumes all 17408 activation elements produced across the full gate/up grid.

resident_grid.risk: Any register, spill, shared-memory, or maximum-thread regression that reduces occupancy below two CTAs/SM invalidates the exact cooperative grid.

minimum_candidate_resource_gate_if_reope.shared_storage_plan: Explicitly alias or union gate/up and down phase storage rather than retaining independent layouts.

cuda_graph.platform_capture_support: Existing production down real-buffer Graph capture, instantiate, and replay evidence establishes cooperative-kernel capture support on the named device.

publish the final 17408-element gated BF16 vector globally
leave the dead-up workspace untouched before it becomes raw-down output
handoff: complete all gated BF16 global stores before cooperative grid synchronization

down: preserve canonical or scale6 exact scale reconstruction
normalized_output preserves the selected 256-thread centered-RMSNorm accumulation and reduction tree, rsqrtf, centered gamma, and BF16-RNE publication

numerical_contract_if_reopened.validation: A future composite must validate the full phase-lifetime alias contract before enqueue, including intentional reuse of the dead-up workspace as raw-down output, and preserve canonical fallback behavior.

performance_ceiling.interpretation: The launch-only mechanism cannot enter the required 0.3-0.5-ms/token region. The ceiling is intentionally optimistic because it charges zero for the required new grid barrier and does not include possible instruction-cache, register-allocation, parameter, or cooperative-launch regressions.

down_residual_norm_fusion.reason_not_comparable: That promotion removed a real standalone 20-CTA residual/norm kernel and reused down-kernel state; it was not a pure empty-boundary launch saving.

output_projection_residual_handoff.reason_relevant: A nearby same-layer handoff transformation that retained two launches and moved exact residual work regressed, showing that boundary rearrangement without material byte or launch savings is not free.

decision.reason: The exact current boundary exposes only 0.0857856 ms/token of GPU idle, host launch setup is already queued far ahead and non-additive, the stated contract eliminates zero global bytes, and a new exact-capacity cooperative grid barrier is mandatory. The mechanism cannot credibly clear the required 0.3-0.5-ms/token region.
decision.reopen_when: Reopen only as a materially different mechanism that removes real projection, epilogue, synchronization, or global-memory work and has a source/profile-backed ceiling of at least 0.3 ms/token after charging cooperative synchronization and exact-boundary costs.

claim_limits: This is a static NO-GO based on current production source and an existing production Nsys trace, not a measured candidate regression or speedup.
The 0.0857856-ms/token value is the exact observed sum of the selected gate/up-to-down GPU gaps in one supporting profile; it is not a general CUDA launch-cost constant.
The approximately 0.419-ms/token gate/up CUDA API duration is overlapped host work and is explicitly not added to the device critical-path ceiling.
Logical activation staging bytes are not claimed as measured DRAM bytes; under the retained global-BF16 contract, however, the candidate removes none of those logical accesses.
No candidate source, binary, GPU run, correctness result, resource result, Graph result, production route, end-to-end result, or new anchor exists.
Production, the 106.763000-ms/token anchor, the serial one-stream schedule, and Prefill remain unchanged.
